body:
## Pull request overview

This PR fixes critical CI build and test failures that were blocking the main branch. The changes address TypeScript compilation errors in ListView.tsx, story files, config components, and example configurations, plus corrects test assertions to match the actual implementation behavior.

**Changes:**
- Fixed type safety issues in ListView.tsx by normalizing QuickFilter items before accessing union type properties and adding required `collapsed` field to grouping config
- Updated test assertions in ListColumnExtensions.test.tsx to expect formatted action labels instead of cell values
- Corrected Storybook type declarations to use component type instead of meta type for stories with required props
- Removed spec-incompatible `type` and `id` fields from dashboard/widget definitions per @objectstack/spec@3.0.9 requirements

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 11 out of 11 changed files in this pull request and generated 1 comment.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx | Fixed TypeScript errors: normalized QuickFilter before accessing `.id`, added required `collapsed: false` to grouping config, added explicit type annotation to map callback |
| packages/plugin-grid/src/ListColumnExtensions.test.tsx | Updated test assertions to expect formatted action label `'ToggleStatus'` instead of cell value `'active'` |
| packages/plugin-designer/src/PageCanvasEditor.stories.tsx | Fixed StoryObj type to use component type instead of meta type |
| packages/plugin-designer/src/DashboardEditor.stories.tsx | Fixed StoryObj type to use component type instead of meta type |
| packages/components/src/custom/config-field-renderer.tsx | Prefixed unused `objectDef` parameter with underscore to suppress lint warning |
| examples/todo/objectstack.config.ts | Removed spec-incompatible `type` field from dashboard and `id` fields from widgets |
| examples/kitchen-sink/objectstack.config.ts | Removed spec-incompatible `type` field from dashboard and `id` fields from widgets |
| examples/crm/src/dashboards/crm.dashboard.ts | Removed spec-incompatible `type` field from dashboard and `id` fields from widgets |
| examples/crm/src/__tests__/crm-metadata.test.ts | Removed test for removed `type` field, updated widget uniqueness test to use `title` instead of removed `id` |
| examples/crm/objectstack.config.ts | Added `as any` type assertion to dashboards array to work around type inference issue |
| ROADMAP.md | Updated last modified date and test count to reflect current state |
</details>

The `as any` type assertion on the dashboards array is masking a type mismatch. Other examples (todo, kitchen-sink) don't require this assertion because they define dashboards inline. Consider either: (1) defining CrmDashboard inline in this file, or (2) ensuring CrmDashboard's exported type matches the expected dashboard input type after removing `type` and `id` fields. The `as any` works but bypasses type safety that could catch future errors.
